execution_environment: ChatGPT Python runtime; CPU; Python 3.13; ldpc==2.4.0

full_12000_trial_followup.configuration: fresh decoder each decimation round, max_iter=500, freeze_epsilon=1e-6

diagnosis: The original failures are highly sensitive to BP iteration count and freeze strength, so insufficient BP convergence and channel-freezing semantics are likely contributors.
Simply rebuilding the BP decoder every decimation round does not resolve the baseline failures at max_iter=100.
Reversing the LLR sign fixes only 4 of 16 and worsens the majority, so a globally reversed reliability sign is not supported.
No tested parameter variant eliminates every pure-BPGD nonconvergence case; therefore the implementation is not yet validated as faithful to the paper.
next_required_checks: Verify whether the paper freezes variables by infinite LLR, exact probability 0/1, or another message-level operation.
Verify whether BP state/messages are restarted or retained after each decimation.
Verify the exact reliability metric and tie-breaking rule.
Verify whether decimation may backtrack, randomize among top reliabilities, or declare failure after all variables are fixed.
Capture immutable syndrome vectors and per-step decimation traces for the remaining failures.
scientific_boundary: The explicit syndrome-safe fallback keeps returned corrections valid, but fallback cases cannot be counted as pure-BPGD successes.
